user.title: Sign in to Amazon
user.description: Use the Amazon account your thermostat is linked to in the Alexa app. After you submit, Amazon's sign-in page opens in a new tab with these details filled in. Finish signing in there, including any robot check or code Amazon asks for. Your password is only used to fill in that page and is never stored.

data_description.amazon_domain: The Amazon site you use for Alexa, for example amazon.com or amazon.co.uk.
data_description.otp_secret: Recommended. In Amazon's Two-Step Verification settings add a new authenticator app, choose "Can't scan the barcode?" and paste the long key shown (spaces are fine). Home Assistant will then fill in the codes for you. Without it, type the code on Amazon's page.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Amazon ended the session for {email}. Enter your password, then finish signing in on Amazon's page that opens in a new tab.

sign_in.title: Sign in on Amazon
sign_in.description: Finish signing in on the Amazon page that opened in a new tab. It closes by itself when you are done.

error.invalid_domain: Enter an Amazon domain such as amazon.com, amazon.de or amazon.co.uk.
error.invalid_otp_secret: The 2FA app key is not valid. Paste the long key Amazon shows under "Can't scan the barcode?" (about 52 letters and digits 2-7), not an email or SMS code.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Amazon. Check your connection and try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the logs for details.
error.sign_in_failed: Amazon did not confirm the sign-in. Make sure you finished it on Amazon's page with the same email, then try again.

abort.already_configured: This Amazon account is already configured.
abort.cannot_connect: Signed in, but Amazon did not return your devices. Try again in a few minutes.
abort.no_thermostats: No thermostat was found on this Amazon account. Make sure it shows up in the Alexa app.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to read the thermostat from Alexa, in seconds. Lower values react faster but make more requests to Amazon.

unknown_previous_mode.message: The thermostat is in Eco mode and its previous mode is not known yet. Choose heat, cool or heat/cool instead.

single_setpoint_in_auto.message: The thermostat is in heat/cool mode. Set the low and high temperatures instead of a single target.

auth_failed.message: The Amazon session expired. Sign in again from the integration page.
